globalNotes: Single vertically-scrolling screen titled "TODAY". Sticky top nav stays fixed: left chevron back-arrow, centered "TODAY" (white, bold, uppercase, letter-spaced), right circular outlined "i" info button. Background is a very dark near-black blue-grey (#0E1419 to #11161C); cards sit on a slightly lighter raised panel (#1A2026 / #20262C) with rounded corners (~16px radius). Status bar shows 09:33 (later 09:34), silent-mode bell-with-slash icon, cellular/wifi, battery 40 then 39. A floating circular WHOOP logo button (purple/blue gradient ring with white W mark) is pinned bottom-right over all scroll positions — opens WHOOP Coach (EXCLUDED feature, treat as decorative/omit). Two large groupings: (1) the TODAY sleep-score summary (ring + 4 metric rows + legend), (2) "Last Night's Sleep" detail cards (Hours of Sleep hypnogram, Hours vs Needed, Sleep Consistency, Sleep Efficiency, Sleep Stress), then (3) "Weekly Trends" — a stack of weekly history cards each with a chevron to drill in. Accent palette: sleep-blue #7FA8C9 / #8FB0CE for primary sleep bars & ring; greens for "optimal"/restorative #3FE0A0-ish; orange #F5A623 for "poor"/high-stress; purples for sleep stages (light #8E8BE8, SWS pink #F09EE6, REM violet #B06AE8). Scroll order follows the 10 filenames top to bottom.

layout.name: Top navigation bar
layout.description: Fixed header. Left: white back chevron (<). Center: 'TODAY' in white, bold, uppercase, ~15px, letter-spaced. Right: circular outlined info icon ('i') ~32px, thin grey ring, grey 'i'. Sits on the dark background, no card.
layout.interaction: Back chevron returns to Home/overview. Info 'i' opens an explainer about the Sleep screen.

layout.name: Sleep Performance ring (big ring)
layout.description: Large centered circular progress ring. Track is dark grey; the progress arc is sleep-blue (#8FB0CE) sweeping most of the circle (about 86%); a short darker grey segment near the top represents the gap. Inside, stacked and centered: faint grey 'WHOOP' wordmark at top, then very large white '86' with smaller '%' superscript (86 is ~80px heavy/extra-bold, % ~32px), then 'SLEEP PERFORMANCE' in white bold uppercase two lines. Below that a tiny 3-segment pill indicator: two grey segments then one green segment (the green = score category Optimal). A small upward triangle/caret sits just under the ring pointing to the metrics card below.
layout.interaction: Tapping the ring opens the Sleep Performance breakdown / score detail.

layout.name: Sleep score components card
layout.description: Rounded card directly under the ring (connected by the caret). Contains 4 metric rows, each: small circular icon on the left, an uppercase white label, a 3-segment horizontal mini progress indicator (segments colored poor/sufficient/optimal), and a large white percentage value on the right. Rows separated by thin hairline dividers.
layout.interaction: Each row likely taps into the corresponding detail card lower on the screen.

layout.name: HOURS VS. NEEDED row
layout.description: Crescent-moon icon. Label 'HOURS VS. NEEDED' white bold uppercase. 3-segment mini bar: two grey (sufficient) segments then a green (optimal) segment lit on the right. Value '100%' large white bold, right-aligned.
layout.interaction: Scrolls/links to the 'HOURS VS. NEEDED' detail card.

layout.name: SLEEP CONSISTENCY row
layout.description: Double-crescent icon. Label 'SLEEP CONSISTENCY' white bold uppercase. 3-segment mini bar with the FIRST (left) segment lit orange (poor) and the rest grey. Value '69%' large white bold right-aligned.
layout.interaction: Links to 'SLEEP CONSISTENCY' detail card.

layout.name: SLEEP EFFICIENCY row
layout.description: Bed/bar-graph icon. Label 'SLEEP EFFICIENCY' white bold uppercase. 3-segment mini bar: two grey then green (optimal) lit on right. Value '92%' large white bold right-aligned.
layout.interaction: Links to 'SLEEP EFFICIENCY' detail card.

layout.name: HIGH SLEEP STRESS row
layout.description: Gauge/speedometer icon. Label 'HIGH SLEEP STRESS' white bold uppercase. 3-segment mini bar: two grey then green (optimal) lit on right. Value '0%' large white bold right-aligned.
layout.interaction: Links to 'SLEEP STRESS' detail card.

layout.name: Score legend pill
layout.description: Rounded dark pill bar spanning the card width below the rows. Three legend items left to right: orange dash + 'Poor', grey dash + 'Sufficient', green dash + 'Optimal'. Text is light grey, sentence case.
layout.interaction: None (static legend).

layout.name: Last Night's Sleep section header
layout.description: Large white title 'Last Night's Sleep' (mixed-case, bold, ~28px). Subtitle beneath: 'Today' in white bold + ' vs. prior 30 days' in grey. On the right: 'EDIT' in white uppercase next to a pencil edit icon.
layout.interaction: EDIT / pencil opens sleep editing (adjust sleep/wake times, add naps).

layout.name: HOURS OF SLEEP card (heart-rate hypnogram)
layout.description: Rounded card. Header 'HOURS OF SLEEP' white bold uppercase with a small circular 'i' info icon top-right. Below header: large white '9:16' with a small green up-triangle (improvement vs baseline) and beneath it small grey baseline '7:44'. Main graphic is a heart-rate line graph across the night.
layout.interaction: Info 'i' explains hours of sleep metric.

layout.name: Overnight heart-rate line chart
layout.description: Line chart of overnight heart rate. Y-axis (left) labels 90, 70, 50, 30 (bpm), grey. The plotted series is a thin light blue-grey jagged HR line (#9FB4C6) that spikes near both ends (sleep onset ~80-90 and wake ~90) and stays low (~50) through the night. Two white dashed vertical marker lines with white dots at the bottom mark sleep start and end. X-axis endpoints labeled '22:31' (left, bedtime) and '08:40' (right, wake). No top X gridline labels between endpoints.
layout.interaction: Likely scrub/tap to read HR at a time point.

layout.name: Sleep stages breakdown (TYPICAL RANGE / DURATION)
layout.description: Below the HR chart, a header row: left 'TYPICAL RANGE' with a small bracket-range icon; right 'DURATION' grey label followed by total '10:09' white bold. Then four sleep-stage rows, each with a white-outlined circle bullet, a stage name, a colored percentage, a horizontal bar showing the stage amount against the typical-range band (a hatched grey track with a lighter dashed window indicating the user's typical range), and the stage duration on the right.
layout.interaction: Static breakdown; possibly taps to staging detail.

layout.name: AWAKE stage row
layout.description: Circle bullet, 'AWAKE' white bold, '8%' in grey next to it. Duration '0:53' white bold right-aligned. Bar below: a light grey filled segment near the left over a hatched grey track, with a dashed typical-range window box around it.
layout.interaction: None / detail.

layout.name: LIGHT stage row
layout.description: Circle bullet, 'LIGHT' white bold, '44%' in light purple (#8E8BE8). Duration '4:22' white bold right-aligned. Bar below: a light-purple filled bar (#9B97F0) extending past mid, ending inside a dashed typical-range window over a hatched grey track.
layout.interaction: None / detail.

layout.name: SWS (DEEP) stage row
layout.description: Circle bullet, 'SWS (DEEP)' white bold, '15%' in pink (#F09EE6). Duration '1:32' white bold right-aligned. Bar below: a short pink filled bar (#F4A8E8) on the left, with a dashed typical-range window just to its right over a hatched grey track.
layout.interaction: None / detail.

layout.name: REM stage row
layout.description: Circle bullet, 'REM' white bold, '33%' in violet (#B06AE8). Duration '3:22' white bold right-aligned. Bar below: a violet filled bar (#B06AE8) extending ~1/3 with a dashed typical-range window straddling its end over a hatched grey track.
layout.interaction: None / detail.

layout.name: RESTORATIVE SLEEP row
layout.description: Separated by a hairline divider. Left: a small pink/violet split-square icon then 'RESTORATIVE SLEEP' white bold uppercase. Right: '4:54' white bold with a small green up-triangle, and beneath it grey baseline '4:00'. (Restorative = SWS + REM combined.)
layout.interaction: None / detail.

layout.name: HOURS VS. NEEDED detail card
layout.description: Rounded card. Header 'HOURS VS. NEEDED' white bold uppercase + circular 'i' info top-right. Below: large white '100%' with green up-triangle, then grey baseline '93%'. Then a two-bar comparison: a 'HOURS OF SLEEP' row (label left, '9:16' value right) shown as a blue gradient horizontal bar nearly full; below it a 'SLEEP NEEDED' bar shown as a grey gradient bar with a small white cap and a blue tick, with label 'SLEEP NEEDED' left and '8:31' value right; a small caret points down to a breakdown box.
layout.interaction: Info 'i' explains the metric.

layout.name: Sleep Needed breakdown box
layout.description: Dark inset rounded box under the Sleep Needed bar with 3 labeled rows, each a small colored square swatch + label (left) and a value (right): grey square 'Healthy Minimum' = '7:47'; blue square 'Recent Strain' = '+0:02'; light-grey square 'Sleep Debt' = '+0:42'. Values white, the '+' additions show how sleep-needed is built up.
layout.interaction: None (static breakdown).

layout.name: SLEEP CONSISTENCY detail card
layout.description: Rounded card. Header 'SLEEP CONSISTENCY' white bold + 'i' info top-right. Below: large white '69%' with an orange down-triangle (decline), then grey baseline '70%'. To the right of the value area a legend: '- - -' grey dashed sample + 'OPTIMAL BED/WAKETIME' grey uppercase. Contains a bed/wake bar chart.
layout.interaction: Info 'i' explains consistency.

layout.name: Sleep consistency bed/wake bar chart
layout.description: Floating-bar chart: each day is a vertical bar spanning from bedtime (top) to waketime (bottom). Y-axis (time-of-day) labels top to bottom: 19:00, 23:00, 03:00, 07:00, 11:00 (grey). X-axis days: Fri, Sat, Sun, Mon, Tue. Fri-Mon bars are grey (#7E868E); the latest 'Tue' bar is sleep-blue (#7FA8C9) and highlighted with a black pill label '22:31' above (bedtime) and '8:40' below (waketime). Two dashed white/grey curved lines run across the chart marking the optimal bedtime band (upper dashed curve ~22:00) and optimal waketime band (lower dashed curve ~07:30).
layout.interaction: Tap a bar to see that night's bed/wake times.

layout.name: SLEEP EFFICIENCY detail card
layout.description: Rounded card. Header 'SLEEP EFFICIENCY' white bold + 'i' info top-right. Below: large white '92%' with orange down-triangle, then grey baseline '95%'. Then an asleep-vs-awake split bar visualization and a wake-events row.

layout.name: Asleep / Awake split bars
layout.description: Two stacked horizontal bars. Top: 'ASLEEP' grey label left, '9:16' white bold right; a long sleep-blue (#8FB0CE) bar segmented into ~10 cells with a small hatched cap at the very left. Bottom: a thin grey track row with a light-grey filled cell at the far left then hatched segments across, labeled 'AWAKE' grey left and '0:52' white bold right. A hairline divider separates this from the wake-events row.
layout.interaction: None.

layout.name: WAKE EVENTS row

layout.name: SLEEP STRESS detail card
layout.description: Rounded card. Header 'SLEEP STRESS' white bold + 'i' info top-right. Below: large white '0%' with a small green down-triangle, then grey baseline '6%'. A small white crescent-moon icon floats over the chart (marks the sleep period). Contains an overnight stress line chart plus High/Medium/Low duration breakdown bars.
layout.interaction: Info 'i' explains sleep stress.

layout.name: Overnight sleep-stress line chart
layout.description: Line chart of overnight stress. Y-axis labels 3.0, 2.0, 1.0, 0.0 (grey). The series is a line that is GREEN (#3FE0A0) where stress is elevated (spiky at the start ~21:30 reaching ~1.7, and again rising at the end near wake) and BLUE (#5FB4D8) where stress is low (the long flat ~0.3 middle of the night) — a green-to-blue gradient along the line. A horizontal light-blue capped reference line sits at 3.0 spanning the shaded sleep window; the sleep window is a faintly shaded rectangle. A white dashed vertical line with a white dot at the right marks 'now'/wake. X-axis labels: '21:31' (left), '01:00', '05:00', '09:25' (right).
layout.interaction: Scrub to read stress value at a time.

layout.name: Sleep-stress High/Medium/Low breakdown
layout.description: Three rows under the chart, each: uppercase label + colored percentage on the left, a horizontal bar (filled colored portion over a hatched grey track) in the middle/under, and a duration on the right. Row 1: 'HIGH' white bold + '0%' orange; bar empty (fully hatched grey); '0:00'. Row 2: 'MEDIUM' white bold + '3%' green; tiny green filled cap at left of hatched track; '0:20'. Row 3: 'LOW' white bold + '97%' blue; nearly-full sleep-blue bar; '9:49'.
